articles.title: Instinct’s powerful AI assistant is raising privacy and security concerns - TechCrunch
articles.description: Early testers are raving about what Instinct can do, but some say the AI assistant’s sweeping access, broad terms and ability to act on users’ behalf come with uncomfortable trade-offs.
